newsitem.title: GREECE: DOWNED GREEK MIRAGE 2000 PILOT STILL MISSING.
newsitem.headline: DOWNED GREEK MIRAGE 2000 PILOT STILL MISSING.

text.p: The pilot of a Greek air force Mirage 2000 fighter jet which crashed in the sea 25 kilometres northeast of the island of Skyros in the Aegean at 10:50 local was still missing, radios said.
The jet was on a training mission and had taken off from Tanagra airport along with three other fighter planes. Its pilot, Ioakim Pantelakis, 30, had logged 400 flight hours.
A search and rescue mission was underway and it was unknown whether the pilot had managed to eject safely.
